line: Kristopher sits in his car exhausted after his routine of grieving and delivering pizzas. He looks at the 5 dollar bill she gave him a couple nights before and puts the digits in his phone. He takes a deep breath and speaks out loud as he hits dial and his car speakers begin ringing. "Protect me Lord from anything not from you."
Violet's phone continues to ring. She knows if she waits another ring that it will go to voicemail.
Kristopher hears Violet's voice say. "Hi it's Violet... Leave a message." Kristopher hangs up before the beep.
Kristopher says out loud. "Fuck it." Then he hits redial.
Violet's phone continues to ring as Kristopher prepares himself to leave a voicemail.
He hangs up the phone realizing that it would be weird to leave a voicemail
